scope: Every tracked *.test.ts/*.test.mjs and Python test file; no test fixtures/helpers counted as test files. Additional manual/rehearsal programs are a separate inventory. Source-derived fields are Inferred unless explicitly Verified.

method.discovery: git ls-files plus test-name pattern; vitest.config.mts include src/**/*.test.ts cross-checked against JSON and CI log.
method.measurement: JSON reporter local, sequential per-file TAP and Python unittest; no update/golden commands, no app build. Dependency setup writes /tmp only.
method.brittleness: Heuristic source locator arrays record line/text evidence; they are not a claim that every match is wrong or that absent matches prove robustness.
method.protected_policy: Conservatively classify security, privacy, medical scoring and immutable output guards as protected. OWNER DECISION REQUIRED for even proven overlap, without deletion recommendation.
method.baseline_setup: Frozen B setup may archive 05b548b and mock readdirSync for named historical files; current discovery tests intentionally stay on current tree.
method.failed_first_attempt: Default sandbox Node child processes produced spawnSync EPERM even for completed subprocesses; first Vitest run interrupted, no usable JSON. Repeated once with supported network permission; final inventory uses the second run only.

runtime_environment.local_limitations: No age/psql/system PostgreSQL tools or pinned Docker images installed. Those missing dependencies are recorded exactly from attempts.

method.import_graph_limits: Lexical relative/alias imports and literal subprocess script paths, including type-only imports; computed paths may be unresolved. Shared imports are candidates only, not evidence of identical assertions. Proposed DB partition must be verified by actual isolated job execution.
method.serialization: One JSON object on one physical row per test file in tests; manual programs are separate rows in manual_and_rehearsal_programs.
